title: Fluffy Pancakes
summary: Tall, tender stacks with a golden crust and a pillowy middle. Whisk, rest, flip — a lazy weekend win every time.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.original: 3 tbsp melted butter, plus more for the pan

steps.step: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk the milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just until combined — a few small lumps are fine and keep the pancakes tender.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes so the baking powder can start working.
Warm a large skillet or griddle over medium heat and brush with a little butter.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter per pancake and cook until bubbles form on top and the edges look set, about 2 minutes.
Flip and cook the other side until golden brown, about 1 to 2 minutes more.
Repeat with the remaining batter, buttering the pan between batches, and serve warm.

title: Classic French Toast
summary: Custardy inside, crisp and caramelized outside — the best way to give day-old bread a second life.

steps.step: In a wide, shallow dish, whisk together the eggs, milk, cinnamon, vanilla extract, sugar, and salt.
Warm a large skillet over medium heat and melt about a tablespoon of the butter.
Dip a slice of bread into the egg mixture, letting it soak for a few seconds per side until saturated but not falling apart.
Lay the soaked slice in the skillet and cook until deep golden brown, about 3 minutes.
Flip and cook the second side until golden and the center feels set when pressed, about 3 minutes more.
Move the finished slice to a plate and repeat with the remaining bread, adding more butter to the pan as needed.
Serve hot, stacked and ready for your favorite toppings.

title: Banana Bread
summary: Deeply moist and gently sweet, built around the bananas that were too speckled to eat plain. One bowl, one loaf, no fuss.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
In a large bowl, mash the bananas with a fork until mostly smooth.
Stir the melted butter into the mashed bananas until combined.
Mix in the sugar, egg, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the batter and stir them in.
Add the flour and stir just until no dry streaks remain — overmixing makes the loaf tough.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 55 to 60 minutes.
Cool the loaf in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn it out onto a rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Soft Scrambled Eggs
summary: Low heat and constant patience turn ordinary eggs into small, silky curds. The secret is never walking away from the pan.

steps.step: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the milk, and whisk until no streaks of white remain.
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over low heat, tilting to coat the bottom.
Pour in the eggs and let them sit undisturbed for 20 seconds before you start stirring.
Push the eggs gently across the pan with a spatula every few seconds, keeping the heat low so they form soft curds instead of browning.
When the eggs look mostly set but still glossy and a bit wet, remove the pan from the heat — they will finish cooking from residual warmth.
Season with salt and pepper and serve right away.

title: Veggie Omelette
summary: A tender folded egg pocket packed with bright vegetables and melted cheese. Ready before your coffee finishes brewing.

steps.step: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper together in a bowl until fully blended.
Melt half the butter in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat and add the bell pepper and onion. Cook, stirring, until just softened, about 2 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted, about 1 minute, then slide the vegetables onto a plate.
Melt the remaining butter in the same skillet and pour in the egg mixture, tilting the pan to spread it evenly.
As the edges set, use a spatula to gently pull them toward the center, tilting the pan so uncooked egg flows to the edge.
When the top is mostly set but still a little glossy, spoon the vegetables and cheddar cheese over one half.
Fold the empty half over the filling and slide the omelette onto a plate to serve.

title: Overnight Oats
summary: Stir it together tonight, wake up to a creamy, ready-to-eat breakfast. Zero stovetop, zero morning effort — just an easy 5-minute stir and an unhurried rest in the fridge.

steps.step: In a jar or container with a lid, combine the rolled oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, honey, and vanilla extract.
Stir well until everything is evenly combined and no dry oats are visible.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, or overnight, so the oats and chia seeds soften and thicken — this part needs no attention from you.
In the morning, give the oats a good stir — add a splash of milk if they seem too thick.
Top with the sliced strawberries and enjoy cold, straight from the jar.

title: Blueberry Muffins
summary: Bakery-style domed tops studded with juicy berries in every bite. One bowl and a muffin tin get you there.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a muffin tin with paper liners.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir just until combined, with a few lumps remaining.
Toss the blueberries with a spoonful of the dry mix left in the bowl before folding them gently into the batter — this keeps them from sinking.
Divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake until golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 18 to 20 minutes.
Let the muffins cool in the tin for 5 minutes before moving them to a rack.

title: Breakfast Burrito
summary: Warm, cheesy, and fully portable — scrambled eggs, crisp potatoes, and sausage rolled up tight for breakfast on the move.

steps.step: Cook the breakfast sausage in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking it into small pieces, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potato to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the edges turn golden, about 4 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and pepper, then pour into the skillet.
Cook, stirring gently, until the eggs are just set, about 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan or the microwave so they fold without cracking.
Divide the egg mixture and cheddar cheese among the tortillas, placing the filling just below the center.
Fold in the sides, then roll the tortilla up from the bottom into a tight burrito.
Serve warm, or wrap tightly in foil to eat on the go.

title: Avocado Toast with Fried Egg
summary: Crunchy toast, cool mashed avocado, and a runny yolk that pulls it all together. Simple enough for a weekday, good enough for guests.

ingredients.name: red pepper flakes
ingredients.original: a pinch of red pepper flakes (optional)

steps.step: Toast the bread until golden and firm enough to hold toppings.
Scoop the avocado into a bowl, add the lemon juice, salt, and pepper, and mash with a fork to your preferred texture.
Warm the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Crack the eggs into the skillet and cook until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft, about 3 minutes. Cover the pan for the last minute if you want the tops to set faster.
Spread the mashed avocado thickly over the toast.
Top each slice with a fried egg and a pinch of red pepper flakes, then serve immediately.

title: Shakshuka
summary: Eggs poached right in a bubbling, spiced tomato sauce, served straight from the pan with bread for scooping.

steps.step: Warm the olive oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat and add the onion and bell pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and bring to a simmer.
Let the sauce simmer, stirring occasionally, until it thickens slightly, about 10 minutes.
Use the back of a spoon to make 6 small wells in the sauce, then crack an egg into each one.
Cover the skillet and cook until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still soft, about 6 to 8 minutes.
Scatter the feta cheese and parsley over the top just before serving.

title: Homemade Granola
summary: Big, crunchy clusters of toasted oats and nuts, sweetened just enough. One tray makes a week of better mornings.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 325°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss together the rolled oats, almonds, cinnamon, and salt.
In a small bowl, whisk the maple syrup, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract together.
Pour the wet mixture over the oats and stir until every piece is coated.
Spread the mixture in an even layer on the baking sheet, pressing down gently to encourage clumps.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until deep golden brown.
Let the granola cool completely on the pan without stirring — this is when the clusters form.
Break the cooled granola into clusters and mix in the dried cranberries before storing in an airtight container.

title: Crispy Hash Browns
summary: Golden and shatteringly crisp on the outside, soft in the middle. The trick is squeezing out every drop of water first.

steps.step: Shred the russet potatoes on the large holes of a box grater into a bowl of cold water.
Drain the shredded potatoes and squeeze them firmly in a clean kitchen towel to remove as much water as possible.
Season the dried shreds generously with salt and pepper.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Spread half the potatoes in an even, thin layer and press down firmly with a spatula.
Cook undisturbed until deeply golden on the bottom, about 5 to 6 minutes.
Flip in sections and cook the second side until crisp and golden, about 4 to 5 minutes more.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining oil and potatoes, then serve hot.

title: Bacon Egg and Cheese Sandwich
summary: Crisp bacon, a soft folded egg, and melted cheese between toasted bread — the deli classic made better at home.

steps.step: Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 6 minutes.
Move the bacon to a paper towel-lined plate and pour off most of the fat, leaving a thin coating in the pan.
Crack the egg into the same skillet, season with salt and pepper, and cook over medium-low heat until the white is set, about 2 minutes.
Fold the egg in half, top with the cheddar cheese, and cover the pan briefly to melt it.
Toast the bread and spread lightly with butter.
Stack the bacon and cheesy egg between the toasted bread and serve warm.

title: Classic Waffles
summary: Crisp, deeply grooved outside with a light, airy inside built to catch every drop of syrup.

steps.step: Heat a waffle iron according to its instructions.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk the egg yolks, milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract until smooth, then stir into the dry ingredients.
In a separate clean bowl, beat the egg whites with a whisk or mixer until they hold soft peaks.
Gently stir a third of the egg whites into the batter to loosen it, then add the rest, folding with a spatula until just streaky — this keeps the waffles light.
Pour the batter onto the hot waffle iron and cook until deeply golden and crisp, following your iron's timing, usually 4 to 5 minutes.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve the waffles hot.

title: Stovetop Oatmeal
summary: Creamy, warm, and endlessly customizable — five minutes of simmering turns oats and milk into real comfort.

steps.step: Combine the milk, water, and salt in a small saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Stir in the rolled oats and reduce the heat to medium-low.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the oats are thick and creamy, about 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in the brown sugar and cinnamon.
Let the oatmeal sit for a minute to thicken further, then spoon into bowls and serve warm.

title: Baked Egg Bites
summary: Light, custardy egg cups you can grab straight from the fridge all week — a muffin tin does all the work.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin well.
Combine the eggs, cottage cheese, and milk in a blender and blend until smooth and frothy.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper.
Divide the spinach, bell pepper, and cheddar cheese evenly among the muffin cups.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables, filling each cup about two-thirds full.
Bake until the egg bites are puffed and set in the center, 20 to 22 minutes.
Let them cool for a few minutes before running a knife around the edges to loosen and serve.

title: Huevos Rancheros
summary: Crisp tortillas layered with beans, a bright tomato sauce, and fried eggs with soft yolks. Bold breakfast, small effort.

ingredients.name: black beans
ingredients.original: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed

steps.step: Heat 2 tablespoons of the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat and fry the corn tortillas one at a time until lightly crisp, about 1 minute per side. Set them on a plate.
In the same skillet, cook the onion and garlic over medium heat until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes and jalapeno, season with salt and pepper, and simmer until slightly thickened, about 6 minutes.
Stir the black beans into the sauce and warm through, about 3 minutes, then move the sauce to a bowl and keep warm.
Wipe out the skillet, add the remaining vegetable oil, and fry the eggs until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft, about 3 minutes.
Set a crisp tortilla on each plate and spoon the tomato-bean sauce over the top.
Top each with a fried egg, then scatter with queso fresco and cilantro before serving.

title: Crustless Quiche
summary: All the rich, custardy comfort of quiche without rolling a single crust. Slice it warm or serve it cold from the fridge.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9-inch pie dish.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook the onion until soft, about 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook just until wilted, about 1 minute, then spread the mixture in the bottom of the pie dish.
Scatter the swiss cheese over the vegetables.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, heavy cream, nutmeg, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables and cheese in the pie dish.
Bake until the center is just set and no longer jiggles when gently shaken, 30 to 35 minutes.
Let the quiche rest for 10 minutes before slicing so it holds together.

title: Vegetable Frittata
summary: A skillet full of eggs and roasted vegetables that starts on the stove and finishes in the oven, puffed and golden.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Warm the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat and cook the onion and zucchini until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook just until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until well blended.
Spread the vegetables evenly in the skillet, then pour the egg mixture over them, tilting the pan so it settles evenly.
Cook undisturbed over medium-low heat until the edges begin to set, about 3 minutes.
Sprinkle the parmesan cheese over the top and transfer the skillet to the oven.
Bake until the center is fully set and puffed, about 12 to 14 minutes.
Let the frittata cool for a few minutes, then slice into wedges to serve.

title: Breakfast Quesadilla
summary: A crisp, folded tortilla stuffed with fluffy eggs and melted cheese — ready in the time it takes to pour coffee.

steps.step: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper together in a bowl.
Melt half the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and scramble the eggs until just set, about 3 minutes. Slide them onto a plate.
Wipe out the skillet, melt the remaining butter, and lay one tortilla flat in the pan.
Sprinkle half the cheddar cheese over one half of the tortilla, then top with the scrambled eggs and the rest of the cheese.
Fold the empty half of the tortilla over the filling and press down gently.
Cook until golden and crisp on the bottom, about 2 minutes, then carefully flip and crisp the other side, about 2 minutes more.
Repeat with the second tortilla, then slice each into wedges and serve with salsa.

title: Chia Pudding
summary: A quiet bowl of stirring turns into a thick, tapioca-like pudding by morning. Naturally sweet and endlessly toppable — just minutes of hands-on work.

steps.step: In a bowl or jar, whisk together the chia seeds, almond milk, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes, then whisk again to break up any clumps of seeds that have settled.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight, until thick and pudding-like — this part needs no attention from you.
Give the pudding a good stir before serving — add a splash of almond milk if it seems too thick.
Spoon into bowls and top with the berries.

title: Berry Smoothie Bowl
summary: Thick enough to eat with a spoon, bright with berries, and finished with a crunchy scatter of toppings.

ingredients.name: sliced strawberries
ingredients.original: 1/4 cup sliced fresh strawberries, for topping

steps.step: Add the frozen mixed berries, frozen banana, yogurt, milk, and honey to a blender.
Blend on high, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed, until thick and smooth — it should be thicker than a drinkable smoothie.
If the mixture is too thick to blend, add a splash more milk; if too thin, add a few more frozen berries.
Pour the mixture into a bowl.
Top with the granola and sliced strawberries and serve right away with a spoon.

title: Biscuits and Gravy
summary: Warm, flaky biscuits buried under a peppery sausage gravy — hearty Southern comfort straight from a single skillet.

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.original: 2 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting

ingredients.name: gravy thickener
ingredients.original: 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, for the gravy

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.original: 1 tsp black pepper, plus more to taste

steps.step: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cut the cold butter into the flour with your fingers or a pastry cutter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces.
Pour in the buttermilk and stir just until a shaggy dough forms.
Turn the dough onto a floured surface, pat it into a 1-inch-thick round, and cut into biscuits with a cutter or glass.
Place the biscuits on the baking sheet and bake until golden on top, 14 to 16 minutes.
While the biscuits bake, cook the breakfast sausage in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking it up, until browned, about 6 minutes.
Sprinkle the gravy thickener over the sausage and stir for 1 minute to cook off the raw flour taste.
Slowly pour in the whole milk while stirring, then simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Season the gravy generously with black pepper, split the warm biscuits, and spoon the gravy over the top to serve.

title: French Toast Casserole
summary: All the flavor of French toast baked into one soft, custardy dish with a crunchy cinnamon-sugar top — built for a crowd.

ingredients.name: streusel topping
ingredients.original: 1/3 cup packed brown sugar, for topping

steps.step: Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish and spread the cubed bread evenly across the bottom.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, heavy cream, sugar, vanilla extract, and cinnamon until smooth.
Pour the egg mixture evenly over the bread cubes, pressing down gently so every piece gets soaked.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight, so the bread fully absorbs the custard — this part needs no attention from you.
When ready to bake, heat the oven to 350°F and drizzle the melted butter over the top of the soaked bread.
Sprinkle the streusel topping evenly over the surface.
Bake until puffed, golden on top, and set in the center, 40 to 45 minutes.
Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before slicing into squares to serve.

title: Egg Muffin Cups
summary: Savory little egg cups loaded with ham, cheese, and peppers — bake a batch and breakfast is handled for days.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin well.
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until fully combined.
Stir in the ham, bell pepper, and green onion.
Divide the mixture evenly among the muffin cups, filling each about two-thirds full.
Sprinkle the cheddar cheese over the top of each cup.
Bake until puffed and set in the center, 18 to 20 minutes.
Let the egg cups cool for a few minutes before running a knife around the edges to lift them out.

title: Marry Me Chicken
summary: Golden chicken breasts in a sun-dried tomato cream sauce so good it earned its nickname. Serve it with something to mop up every drop.

steps.step: Pat the chicken breasts dry, season both sides with salt and pepper, and dust lightly with the flour, shaking off the excess.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken until deeply golden, about 5 minutes per side. Move it to a plate — it will finish cooking later.
Lower the heat to medium, add the garlic to the same skillet, and stir just until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up the browned bits on the bottom of the pan — that's where the flavor is.
Stir in the heavy cream, sun-dried tomatoes, and italian seasoning, and let the sauce bubble gently until it thickens slightly, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan until melted and smooth.
Return the chicken and any juices to the skillet, spoon sauce over the top, and simmer until the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the center, about 8 minutes.
Scatter the basil over the top just before serving.

title: Easy Chicken Curry
summary: A weeknight curry with real depth: tender chicken simmered in a spiced tomato-coconut sauce. Ready faster than delivery.

ingredients.name: chicken thighs
ingredients.original: 1.5 lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks

steps.step: Warm the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion, stirring often, until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the curry powder and stir constantly for 30 seconds to toast the spices and wake up their flavor.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and coconut milk, stir well, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the chicken and salt, stir to coat every piece in sauce, and simmer uncovered until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink inside, about 18 minutes.
Taste and adjust the salt, then scatter the cilantro over the top before serving.

title: Butter Chicken
summary: Yogurt-marinated chicken simmered in a velvety, lightly spiced tomato butter sauce. Rich, comforting, and worth the extra few minutes.

ingredients.name: chicken thighs
ingredients.original: 1.5 lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks

steps.step: In a bowl, stir together the chicken, yogurt, and half the garam masala, and let it sit for at least 15 minutes — this tenderizes and seasons the meat.
Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the marinated chicken until lightly browned on the outside, about 6 minutes. It doesn't need to be fully cooked yet.
Move the chicken to a plate, add the remaining butter to the skillet, and cook the onion until soft and golden, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, ginger, and remaining garam masala, and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Pour in the tomato puree and salt, bring to a simmer, and cook until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream, then return the chicken and any juices to the skillet.
Simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the center, about 8 minutes.
Scatter the cilantro over the top before serving.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
summary: Crisp-tender vegetables and juicy chicken in a glossy savory sauce, all done in one pan faster than takeout arrives.

steps.step: Whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar, and cornstarch in a small bowl until smooth, then set the sauce aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat until shimmering.
Add the chicken in a single layer and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Move it to a plate.
Add the broccoli, bell pepper, and carrot to the same pan and stir-fry until crisp-tender and bright, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce, and toss until everything is glossy and coated and the sauce has thickened, about 2 minutes.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the top and toss once more before serving.

title: Chicken Fajitas
summary: Sizzling strips of spiced chicken and sweet peppers, hot off the skillet. Pile it into warm tortillas and let everyone build their own.

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.original: 1.5 lb chicken breast, sliced into strips

steps.step: In a large bowl, toss the chicken strips with the chili powder, cumin, paprika, and salt until evenly coated.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a large skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through with no pink inside, about 6 minutes. Move it to a plate.
Add the remaining oil to the pan along with the bell peppers and onion, and cook, stirring often, until softened with light char marks, about 6 minutes.
Return the chicken to the pan and squeeze the lime juice over everything, tossing to combine.
Serve immediately with the warm tortillas alongside for building your own fajitas.

title: Chicken Parmesan
summary: Crispy breaded chicken under bubbling marinara and melted cheese. A diner favorite that's simpler at home than you'd think.

ingredients.name: chicken breasts
ingredients.original: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded thin

steps.step: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Set up three shallow dishes: one with flour, one with the beaten eggs, and one with the breadcrumbs mixed with half the parmesan.
Dredge each chicken breast in flour, then egg, then the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently so the coating sticks.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side.
Spoon the marinara sauce over each piece of chicken, then scatter the mozzarella and remaining parmesan on top.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is melted and bubbling, about 15 minutes.
Let the chicken rest for a couple of minutes, then scatter the basil over the top before serving.

title: Whole Roast Chicken
summary: Golden, crackly skin and juicy meat with almost no effort — just butter, salt, and time doing the real work.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 425°F and take the chicken out of the fridge to lose its chill while the oven heats.
Pat the chicken completely dry inside and out with paper towels — this is the secret to crisp skin.
Stuff the cavity with the lemon, garlic, rosemary, thyme, and onion.
Rub the softened butter all over the outside of the chicken, then season generously with salt and pepper.
Tie the legs together with kitchen twine and tuck the wing tips under the body so they don't burn.
Place the chicken breast-side up in a roasting pan and roast until the skin is deep golden and a thermometer in the thickest part of the thigh reads 165°F, about 75 minutes.
Let the chicken rest for 10 minutes before carving — this keeps the juices in the meat instead of on the cutting board.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
summary: Simple, steamy, and soul-settling — tender chicken, soft noodles, and a broth that tastes like it simmered all day.

steps.step: Warm the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots, and celery, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in the chicken broth, add the chicken breasts, and season with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Simmer, partially covered, until the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the center, about 15 minutes.
Lift the chicken out onto a cutting board, shred it into bite-sized pieces with two forks, and return it to the pot.
Add the egg noodles to the simmering broth and cook until tender, about 8 minutes.
Taste and adjust the salt and pepper, then stir in the parsley before serving.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
summary: Creamy chicken and vegetables tucked under a flaky golden crust. The kind of comfort food that makes a kitchen smell like home.

ingredients.name: chicken breasts
ingredients.original: 1.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cubed

steps.step: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots, and celery, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until no longer pink on the outside, about 6 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over everything and stir constantly for 1 minute to cook off the raw taste.
Slowly pour in the chicken broth and milk, stirring constantly, and simmer until thickened enough to coat the back of a spoon, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the frozen peas and season with salt and pepper, then remove from the heat.
Fit one pie crust into a deep pie dish, pour in the filling, and top with the second crust, pinching the edges together and cutting a few small slits for steam to escape.
Bake until the crust is deep golden brown and the filling is bubbling through the slits, about 30 minutes.
Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before slicing so the filling can set.

title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
summary: Seared chicken swimming in a creamy garlic sauce with spinach and sun-dried tomatoes. Restaurant-fancy, one-skillet easy.

steps.step: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken until golden and cooked through with no pink in the center, about 6 minutes per side. Move it to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium, add the garlic to the same skillet, and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Stir in the heavy cream, parmesan, and sun-dried tomatoes, and simmer gently until slightly thickened, about 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir just until wilted, about 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the skillet, spoon the sauce over the top, and warm through for a minute before serving.

title: Chicken Alfredo
summary: Silky parmesan cream sauce clinging to every noodle, with juicy sliced chicken on top. Simple ingredients, big payoff.

steps.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine according to the package until just tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, reserving a cup of the pasta water.
While the pasta cooks, season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.

Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until golden and cooked through with no pink inside, about 6 minutes per side. Move it to a cutting board to rest, then slice.
In the same skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and cook the garlic until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring often, about 3 minutes.
Whisk in the parmesan until the sauce is smooth, thinning with a splash of reserved pasta water if it looks too thick.
Add the drained fettuccine to the sauce and toss until every strand is coated.
Top with the sliced chicken and scatter the parsley over everything before serving.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
summary: Crisp golden tortillas packed with melty cheese and seasoned shredded chicken. Ready in less time than it takes to set the table.

steps.step: In a bowl, toss the shredded chicken with the chili powder, cumin, and salt until evenly coated.
Lay out half the tortillas and scatter the cheddar cheese, seasoned chicken, and bell pepper evenly over each. Top with the remaining tortillas.
Melt a little of the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and place one quesadilla in the pan.
Cook until the bottom is golden and crisp, about 3 minutes, then carefully flip and cook the other side until golden and the cheese is fully melted, about 3 minutes more.
Repeat with the remaining butter and quesadillas.
Slice each quesadilla into wedges and serve while the cheese is still stretchy.

title: Honey Garlic Chicken
summary: Juicy chicken bites glazed in a sticky-sweet garlic sauce that clings to every piece. Sweet, savory, and gone in minutes.

ingredients.name: chicken thighs
ingredients.original: 1.5 lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces

steps.step: Season the chicken pieces with salt and pepper, then toss with the cornstarch until lightly coated.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through with no pink inside, about 8 minutes.
Push the chicken to one side of the pan, add the garlic to the empty space, and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Whisk together the honey, soy sauce, and rice vinegar in a small bowl, then pour it over the chicken.
Toss everything together and simmer until the sauce thickens into a glossy glaze that coats the chicken, about 3 minutes.
Scatter the green onion over the top before serving.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
summary: Day-old rice gets a second life with tender chicken, scrambled egg, and a hit of soy — better than the takeout container.

steps.step: Heat half the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat and cook the chicken, seasoned with salt and pepper, until golden and cooked through, about 6 minutes. Move it to a plate.
Push everything to one side, pour the beaten eggs into the empty space, and scramble them until just set, about 1 minute.
Add the remaining oil, then the frozen peas and carrots, and cook, stirring, until warmed through, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the cold rice, breaking up any clumps with your spatula, and stir-fry until heated through, about 4 minutes.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the soy sauce and sesame oil, and toss until everything is evenly coated.
Scatter the green onion over the top before serving.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Charred, spice-marinated chicken bathed in a creamy tomato sauce. Bold enough for a special dinner, simple enough for a Tuesday.

ingredients.name: chicken thighs
ingredients.original: 1.5 lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks

steps.step: In a bowl, stir together the chicken, yogurt, half the garam masala, and the paprika, and let it marinate for at least 20 minutes in the fridge.

Heat half the vegetable oil in a large skillet over high heat and cook the marinated chicken in a single layer until charred at the edges, about 6 minutes. Move it to a plate — it will finish cooking in the sauce.
Add the remaining oil to the pan and cook the onion, stirring occasionally, until soft and golden, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, ginger, and remaining garam masala, and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Pour in the tomato puree and salt, bring to a simmer, and cook until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream, then return the chicken and any juices to the pan.
Simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the center, about 8 minutes.
Scatter the cilantro over the top before serving.

title: BBQ Chicken Thighs
summary: Sticky, caramelized chicken thighs with crackly skin and a smoky-sweet glaze. A backyard favorite you can make any night.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Pat the chicken thighs dry and toss them with the olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Arrange the thighs skin-side up on a rimmed baking sheet and bake until the skin is golden and starting to crisp, about 25 minutes.
Brush the bbq sauce generously over each thigh and return to the oven until the sauce is sticky and caramelized and the chicken reaches 165°F inside, about 10 minutes.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving so the glaze can set.

title: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
summary: Crisp romaine, crunchy croutons, and warm sliced chicken tossed in a garlicky, tangy dressing. A salad hearty enough for dinner.

steps.step: Season the chicken breasts on both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a grill pan or large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until golden with clear grill marks and cooked through with no pink inside, about 6 minutes per side.
Move the chicken to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing — this keeps it juicy.
While the chicken rests, toss the romaine lettuce and croutons together in a large bowl.
Drizzle the caesar dressing over the lettuce and toss until every leaf is lightly coated.
Divide the salad among plates, top with the sliced chicken, and finish with shaved parmesan.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken
summary: Bright lemon and fresh herbs turn simple pan-seared chicken into something worth repeating. Light, fast, and full of flavor.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.original: 2 lemons, one juiced and one sliced

steps.step: Season the chicken breasts on both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken until golden, about 5 minutes per side. Move it to a plate — it will finish cooking in the sauce.
Lower the heat to medium, add the garlic to the same skillet, and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in the chicken broth and lemon juice, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Add the lemon slices and thyme, then return the chicken to the pan.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the center, about 8 minutes.
Swirl in the butter until it melts into a light, glossy sauce, then spoon it over the chicken before serving.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
summary: Soft tortillas rolled around seasoned shredded chicken and cheese, blanketed in sauce and baked until bubbly at the edges.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 375°F.
In a large bowl, mix the shredded chicken with 1 cup of the cheddar cheese, the onion, cumin, salt, and 1/2 cup of the enchilada sauce.
Spread a thin layer of enchilada sauce across the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.
Spoon a portion of the chicken filling down the center of each tortilla, roll it up snugly, and place it seam-side down in the dish.
Pour the remaining enchilada sauce evenly over the rolled tortillas, making sure to cover the ends so they don't dry out.
Scatter the remaining cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake until the sauce is bubbling at the edges and the cheese is fully melted, about 25 minutes.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes, then scatter the cilantro over the top before serving.

title: One-Pot Chicken and Rice
summary: Juicy chicken thighs simmered right on top of savory rice, so the rice soaks up every bit of flavor. One pot, minimal cleanup.

steps.step: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season both sides with the paprika, salt, and pepper.

Heat the olive oil in a large deep skillet or pot over medium-high heat and sear the chicken skin-side down until golden and crisp, about 6 minutes. Flip and sear the other side for 3 minutes, then move it to a plate.
In the same pot, cook the onion in the rendered fat, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the rice and stir for about a minute so each grain gets coated in the flavorful fat.
Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Nestle the chicken thighs skin-side up on top of the rice, bring to a simmer, then cover and cook until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through, about 22 minutes.
Let the pot rest off the heat for 5 minutes, then scatter the parsley over the top before serving.

title: Baked Mac and Cheese
summary: Elbow pasta baked in a rich, sharp cheese sauce with a golden crust on top. Comfort food that never goes out of style.

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.original: 3 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided

steps.step: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the elbow macaroni until just tender, about 8 minutes. Drain and set aside.
In the same pot, melt the butter over medium heat, then whisk in the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk while whisking, and cook until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, about 6 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in 2 cups of the cheddar cheese and season with salt and pepper until smooth.
Add the cooked macaroni to the cheese sauce and stir until every piece is coated.
Pour the mixture into a greased baking dish, top with the remaining cheddar cheese and the breadcrumbs.
Bake until golden and bubbling at the edges, about 20 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: Silky egg and cheese sauce clinging to hot pasta with crisp bits of pork — no cream needed, just technique and good timing.

ingredients.name: parmesan
ingredients.original: 1 cup grated parmesan, plus more for serving

steps.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until just tender, about 9 minutes. Reserve a cup of the pasta water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, whisk the eggs, parmesan, and black pepper together in a bowl until smooth. Set aside.
In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the bacon until crisp and browned, about 6 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds, then turn off the heat.
Add the drained hot spaghetti to the skillet with the bacon and toss to coat in the fat.
Off the heat, pour in the egg mixture and toss quickly and constantly so the eggs turn creamy instead of scrambling — the pasta's heat is what cooks them.
Add splashes of the reserved pasta water as needed until the sauce is glossy and coats the noodles, then season with salt to taste.
Serve right away with extra parmesan on top.

title: Penne Arrabbiata
summary: A punchy, garlicky tomato sauce with a real kick of chili, tossed with pasta that holds its bite. Simple pantry ingredients, big flavor.

steps.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne until just tender, about 11 minutes. Drain and set aside.

While the pasta cooks, warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add the garlic and red pepper flakes, stirring until the garlic turns light golden, about 2 minutes. Watch closely so it doesn't burn.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and salt, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 12 minutes.
Add the drained penne to the sauce and toss until every piece is coated.
Scatter the basil over the top before serving.

title: Pesto Pasta
summary: Bright basil pesto tossed with hot pasta and a splash of its own cooking water for a silky, herby coat on every bite.

steps.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fusilli until just tender, about 11 minutes. Reserve a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, toast the pine nuts in a dry small skillet over medium heat, shaking the pan often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Watch closely — they burn fast.
In a food processor, combine the basil, toasted pine nuts, parmesan, garlic, and salt, and pulse until finely chopped.
With the processor running, slowly stream in the olive oil until the pesto is smooth and thick.
Toss the drained fusilli with the pesto in a large bowl, adding splashes of the reserved pasta water until the sauce coats every piece.
Fold in the cherry tomatoes and serve right away.

title: Baked Ziti
summary: Tender pasta layered with marinara and three cheeses, baked until the top turns golden and bubbly. A crowd-pleaser worth doubling.

steps.step: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the ziti until just barely tender, about 8 minutes — it will finish cooking in the oven. Drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, stir together the ricotta cheese, egg, parmesan, basil, and a pinch of salt and pepper until smooth.
Add the drained ziti and half the marinara sauce to the ricotta mixture and stir until evenly combined.
Spread a thin layer of the remaining marinara sauce in the bottom of a greased 9x13 baking dish.
Pour the pasta mixture into the dish, top with the remaining marinara sauce, then scatter the mozzarella evenly over the top.
Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes, then uncover and bake until the cheese is melted and golden in spots, about 15 minutes more.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving so it holds together when sliced.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
summary: A slow-simmered, deeply savory meat sauce over twirlable noodles. Weeknight easy, Sunday-dinner satisfying.

steps.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the spaghetti.
Warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onion and carrot until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the ground beef, breaking it into small crumbles with a spoon, and cook until no pink remains, about 7 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute so it darkens slightly and loses its raw edge.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and oregano, season with salt and pepper, and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in the boiling water until just tender, about 10 minutes, then drain.
Divide the spaghetti among bowls, spoon the sauce over the top, and finish with grated parmesan.

title: Chili con Carne
summary: Thick, spoonable, and packed with beans and beef — this is the chili you make a double batch of on purpose.

ingredients.name: kidney beans
ingredients.original: 15 oz canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps.step: Brown the ground beef in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks, about 7 minutes.
Spoon off excess fat, then add the onion and bell pepper and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, and cumin and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, kidney beans, and beef broth, and season with salt and pepper.
Bring to a gentle simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until thick and rich, about 30 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning before ladling into bowls.

title: Classic Meatloaf
summary: A tender, juicy loaf with a sweet-tangy glaze baked right on top. Old-fashioned comfort that slices clean every time.

steps.step: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment.
In a small bowl, soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for a couple of minutes until softened.

In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, soaked breadcrumbs, egg, onion, 2 tablespoons of the ketchup, the worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Mix gently with your hands until just combined — overworking makes it dense.
Shape the mixture into a firm loaf on the prepared pan.
Stir the remaining ketchup with the brown sugar and spread it evenly over the top of the loaf.
Bake until a thermometer inserted in the center reads 160°F, about 55 minutes.
Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing so the juices settle.

title: Beef Tacos
summary: Seasoned beef, crisp lettuce, and melty cheese folded into warm tortillas. A ten-ingredient dinner everyone assembles themselves.

steps.step: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into small pieces, about 6 minutes.
Drain any excess fat, then stir in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and water.
Simmer until the water mostly evaporates and the beef looks glossy and coated, about 5 minutes.
Spoon the beef into the warm taco shells.
Top with lettuce, tomato, and cheddar cheese, and serve right away while the shells are crisp.

title: Classic Cheeseburgers
summary: A juicy, well-seasoned patty melted under cheese and stacked in a soft bun. Backyard-grill flavor from a stovetop skillet.

steps.step: Divide the ground beef into 4 equal portions and shape into patties slightly wider than the buns — they shrink as they cook.
Press a shallow dimple in the center of each patty with your thumb and season both sides generously with salt and pepper.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the patties until deeply browned, about 4 minutes per side for medium.
Lay a slice of cheddar cheese on each patty during the last minute of cooking and let it melt.
Toast the burger buns cut-side down in the same skillet until lightly golden, about 1 minute.
Build each burger with lettuce, tomato, onion, and ketchup, then set the patty on top and close the bun.

title: Beef Stew
summary: Fork-tender beef, soft potatoes, and sweet carrots in a broth that turns rich with time. The stew you start and forget about.

ingredients.name: beef chuck
ingredients.original: 2 lb beef chuck, cut into 1.5-inch cubes

steps.step: Pat the beef cubes dry, season with salt and pepper, and toss with the flour until lightly coated.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 3 minutes per side, so you don't crowd the pot. Set the beef aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 4 minutes, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom.
Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return the beef to the pot, pour in the beef broth, and add the bay leaves. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and simmer on low heat, stirring occasionally, until the beef starts to soften, about 1 hour 15 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots and continue simmering, uncovered, until the vegetables and beef are fork-tender, about 40 minutes.
Discard the bay leaves, taste and adjust the seasoning, and ladle into bowls while hot.

title: Beef Stroganoff
summary: Tender strips of beef and earthy mushrooms in a silky sour cream sauce, spooned over egg noodles. Elegant enough for guests, easy enough for Tuesday.

steps.step: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the egg noodles until tender, then drain.

Season the sliced beef with salt and pepper. Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a large skillet over high heat and sear the beef in batches until just browned, about 1 minute per side. Set the beef aside.
Melt the remaining butter in the same skillet over medium heat, then add the onion and mushrooms and cook until the mushrooms release their liquid and turn golden, about 7 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and flour and cook for 1 minute, coating the vegetables evenly.
Slowly whisk in the beef broth, scraping up any browned bits, and simmer until slightly thickened, about 4 minutes.
Lower the heat and stir in the sour cream and dijon mustard until smooth — do not let it boil, or the sauce can curdle.
Return the beef and any collected juices to the skillet and warm through for 1 to 2 minutes.
Spoon the stroganoff over the egg noodles and serve immediately.

title: Cottage Pie
summary: A savory beef and vegetable filling under a blanket of buttery mashed potato, baked until the peaks turn golden. Deeply cozy.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.original: 2 lb potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks

steps.step: Put the potatoes in a large pot of salted water, bring to a boil, and cook until tender when pierced with a fork, about 15 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with the butter and milk until smooth. Season with salt and pepper and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 400°F.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the ground beef, breaking it into crumbles, about 7 minutes.
Add the onion and carrots and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, beef broth, and worcestershire sauce, and simmer until slightly thickened, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the frozen peas, then spread the filling evenly in a baking dish.
Spoon the mashed potato over the filling and spread to the edges, dragging a fork across the top to make ridges that will crisp up.
Bake until the top is golden and the filling bubbles at the edges, about 25 minutes.

title: Lasagna
summary: Layers of pasta, meaty tomato sauce, and three cheeses baked until bubbling. A weekend project worth every layer.

steps.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the lasagna noodles until just tender, about 9 minutes, then drain and lay flat so they don't stick.
Preheat the oven to 375°F.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the ground beef with the onion, breaking the meat into small pieces, about 7 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute, then add the crushed tomatoes and basil, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a bowl, stir together the ricotta cheese, egg, and a pinch of salt and pepper until smooth.

Spread a thin layer of meat sauce in the bottom of a baking dish, then layer noodles, ricotta mixture, meat sauce, and mozzarella. Repeat the layers twice more, ending with sauce and mozzarella on top.
Sprinkle the parmesan over the top, cover the dish tightly with foil, and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake until the cheese is golden and bubbling, about 15 more minutes.
Let the lasagna rest for 10 minutes before slicing so the layers hold together.

title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
summary: Glossy, savory-sweet beef and crisp-tender broccoli, ready faster than delivery. A takeout favorite made at home.

ingredients.name: flank steak
ingredients.original: 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain

steps.step: Toss the sliced flank steak with 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce and the cornstarch until evenly coated.
Whisk together the remaining soy sauce, the beef broth, and the brown sugar in a small bowl to make the sauce.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat and sear the beef in a single layer until browned, about 2 minutes per side. Set the beef aside.
Add the remaining oil to the pan, then stir-fry the broccoli until bright green and just tender, about 4 minutes.
Push the broccoli to the side, add the garlic and ginger to the open space, and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Return the beef to the pan, pour in the sauce, and toss everything together until the sauce thickens and coats evenly, about 2 minutes.
Serve hot over cooked rice.

title: Sloppy Joes
summary: Tangy, saucy ground beef piled onto soft buns until they can barely hold together. Messy in the best way.

steps.step: Cook the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into small pieces, until browned, about 6 minutes.
Drain excess fat, then add the onion and bell pepper and cook until softened, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the ketchup, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, and tomato paste, and season with salt and pepper.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thick and glossy, about 10 minutes.
Toast the burger buns lightly if you like, then pile the beef mixture generously onto the bottom halves and close with the tops.

title: Meatballs in Marinara
summary: Tender, well-seasoned meatballs simmered gently in a bright tomato sauce until they soak up all that flavor. Serve them however you like your carbs.

steps.step: In a large bowl, mix the ground beef, breadcrumbs, parmesan, egg, half the garlic, salt, and pepper until just combined.
Roll the mixture into golf ball-sized meatballs, about 16 total.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the meatballs on all sides, about 6 minutes total — they don't need to be cooked through yet.
Remove the meatballs to a plate, then add the remaining garlic to the skillet and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and dried basil, and season with salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer.
Nestle the meatballs back into the sauce, cover, and simmer on low until cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Serve the meatballs and sauce hot, spooning extra sauce over the top.

title: Philly Cheesesteak Sandwich
summary: Thin-sliced steak and melted cheese piled into a toasted roll with sweet peppers and onions. Street-cart flavor from your own stove.

ingredients.name: ribeye steak
ingredients.original: 1.25 lb ribeye steak, very thinly sliced

steps.step: Heat half the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the onion and bell pepper until soft and lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Move them to a plate.
Add the remaining oil to the skillet and raise the heat to high. Add the sliced ribeye in a thin layer and season with salt and pepper.
Cook the steak, chopping it into smaller pieces with a spatula as it browns, until no pink remains, about 4 minutes.
Return the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and mix with the steak.
Divide the mixture into 4 mounds in the skillet and lay 2 slices of provolone cheese over each mound. Cover and let the cheese melt, about 2 minutes.
Scoop each cheesy mound into a hoagie roll and serve right away.

title: Korean Beef Rice Bowl
summary: Sweet, garlicky ground beef spooned over warm rice with a sesame finish. Bold flavor in the time it takes rice to cook.

ingredients.name: red pepper flakes
ingredients.original: a pinch of red pepper flakes (optional)

steps.step: Cook the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into small crumbles, until browned, about 6 minutes. Drain any excess fat.
Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes, and stir to coat the beef evenly.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and clings to the meat.
Spoon the beef over bowls of warm rice.
Scatter the green onion and sesame seeds over the top before serving.

title: Sunday Pot Roast
summary: A big, unhurried roast that turns fall-apart tender in the oven while vegetables soak up all its juices. The dinner that fills the whole house with smell.

steps.step: Preheat the oven to 325°F. Pat the chuck roast dry and season all over generously with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium-high heat and sear the roast on all sides until deeply browned, about 10 minutes total. Set the roast aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until it starts to soften and picks up the browned bits, about 4 minutes. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the beef broth, add the bay leaves and thyme, and return the roast to the pot.
Cover and transfer to the oven. Cook until the roast is starting to turn tender, about 1 hour 50 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes around the roast, cover, and return to the oven until the meat shreds easily with a fork and the vegetables are tender, about 45 minutes.
Lift the roast onto a cutting board, discard the bay leaves, and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing or shredding.
Serve the sliced roast with the vegetables and spoon the pan juices over the top.

title: Pork Chops with Apples
summary: Golden seared pork chops finished in a buttery apple and thyme pan sauce. A cozy pairing that feels like fall in one skillet.

steps.step: Pat the pork chops dry and season both sides generously with salt and pepper.
Melt half the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the pork chops until golden brown, about 4 minutes per side. Move them to a plate.
Melt the remaining butter in the same skillet, then add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the apples and dried thyme and cook, stirring occasionally, until the apples begin to soften and turn golden at the edges, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Nestle the pork chops back into the skillet along with any juices and simmer until the pork is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Serve the pork chops topped with the apples and pan sauce.

title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
summary: A well-seasoned pork shoulder that braises low and slow until it pulls apart with a fork. Mostly hands-off, entirely worth the wait.

steps.step: Preheat the oven to 300°F. In a small bowl, mix the brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to make a dry rub.
Rub the mixture all over the pork shoulder, pressing it into the surface.
Scatter the onion in the bottom of a large oven-safe pot with a lid and set the pork on top.
Pour the chicken broth and apple cider vinegar around the pork, cover tightly, and transfer to the oven.
Braise until the pork shreds easily with two forks, about 3 hours, checking once partway through that there is still liquid in the pot.
Lift the pork onto a cutting board and shred it with two forks, discarding any large pieces of fat.
Return the shredded pork to the pot and toss with enough of the cooking liquid to keep it moist.
Pile the pulled pork onto burger buns and serve warm.

title: Carnitas Tacos
summary: Pork simmered until meltingly tender, then crisped in its own fat for crunchy edges. Tucked into warm tortillas with lime and onion.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder
ingredients.original: 3 lb pork shoulder, cut into large chunks

steps.step: Season the pork chunks generously with salt and pepper and place them in a large pot.
Add the orange juice, lime juice, garlic, cumin, dried oregano, and chicken broth to the pot.
Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook on low heat until the pork is fall-apart tender, about 2 hours 30 minutes, checking occasionally that there is still liquid in the pot.
Uncover and simmer until most of the liquid has evaporated, about 15 minutes, then shred the pork right in the pot with two forks.
Spread the shredded pork on a baking sheet and broil until the edges turn crisp and golden, about 5 minutes, watching closely so it doesn't burn.
Pile the crispy pork into warm corn tortillas and top with the diced onion and cilantro.

title: Sausage and White Bean Casserole
summary: Browned sausage and creamy white beans baked together in a rosemary-scented tomato sauce. A rustic, one-dish dinner.

ingredients.name: cannellini beans
ingredients.original: 2 cans (15 oz each) cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

steps.step: Preheat the oven to 375°F.

Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat and brown the sausage links on all sides, about 6 minutes. Move them to a plate and slice into thick coins once cool enough to handle.
Add the onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 4 minutes, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, cannellini beans, chicken broth, and dried rosemary, and season with salt and pepper.
Nestle the sliced sausage back into the mixture and bring to a simmer on the stovetop.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake, uncovered, until bubbling and slightly thickened, about 20 minutes.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork
summary: Crisp fried pork tossed in a tangy, ruby-red sauce with peppers and pineapple. Bright, sticky, and impossible to stop eating.

ingredients.name: pork loin
ingredients.original: 1 lb pork loin, cut into bite-size cubes

steps.step: Toss the pork cubes with the beaten egg, then coat evenly in half the cornstarch, shaking off the excess.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the pork in batches until golden and cooked through, about 4 minutes per batch. Drain on paper towels.
Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of oil, then add the bell pepper and cook until just tender, about 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the ketchup, rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and the remaining cornstarch dissolved in 3 tablespoons of water.
Pour the sauce into the skillet with the bell pepper and simmer until thickened and glossy, about 2 minutes.
Add the pineapple and fried pork to the skillet and toss until everything is coated and warmed through, about 2 minutes.
Serve immediately over cooked rice.

title: Pork Fried Rice
summary: Leftover rice transformed into a smoky, savory skillet dinner with pork, egg, and peas. A pantry-clearing favorite.

steps.step: Heat 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat and cook the pork until browned and cooked through, about 4 minutes. Move it to a plate.
Push the pan's contents aside, pour in the beaten eggs, and scramble until just set, about 1 minute. Move the eggs to the plate with the pork.
Add the remaining oil, then the onion, and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the frozen peas and carrots and garlic and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry until it starts to crisp in spots, about 4 minutes.
Return the pork and eggs to the pan, drizzle with the soy sauce and sesame oil, and toss until evenly combined and heated through, about 2 minutes.
Sprinkle the green onion over the top and serve hot.

title: Bangers and Mash
summary: Snappy fried sausages set on a cloud of buttery mash with a deep onion gravy poured over the top. British comfort food at its plainest and best.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.original: 2 lb potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks

steps.step: Put the potatoes in a large pot of salted water, bring to a boil, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.

While the potatoes cook, melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a skillet over medium heat and fry the sausages, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through, about 12 minutes. Move them to a plate.
In the same skillet, melt 1 more tablespoon of butter and cook the onion over medium-low heat, stirring often, until deeply golden and soft, about 15 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the onion and stir for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the beef broth. Simmer until thickened into a gravy, about 4 minutes, and season with salt and pepper.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the remaining butter and the milk until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
Return the sausages to the gravy to warm through, about 1 minute.
Serve the sausages and onion gravy over a mound of mashed potato.

title: Glazed Pork Tenderloin
summary: A seared pork tenderloin brushed with a sticky honey-mustard glaze and roasted until juicy. Special enough for company, simple enough for tonight.

steps.step: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Pat the pork tenderloin dry and season all over with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat and sear the tenderloin on all sides until browned, about 6 minutes total.
In a small bowl, whisk together the honey, dijon mustard, garlic, and apple cider vinegar to make the glaze.
Brush half the glaze over the seared tenderloin, then transfer the skillet to the oven.
Roast until a thermometer inserted in the thickest part reads 145°F, about 15 minutes, brushing with the remaining glaze halfway through.
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing so the juices redistribute.

title: Sausage and Peppers Pasta
summary: Browned sausage and sweet peppers tossed with pasta in a light tomato sauce. A hearty, one-pot dinner with big flavor and little cleanup.

ingredients.name: pork sausage
ingredients.original: 1 lb pork sausage links, casings removed

steps.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne until just tender, about 11 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the sausage, breaking it into crumbles, until browned, about 6 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer until slightly thickened, about 8 minutes.
Add the drained penne to the skillet and toss until well coated in the sauce.
Serve topped with grated parmesan.

title: Tomato Basil Pasta
summary: A bright, garlicky tomato sauce finished with fresh basil and a swirl of cream. Simple pantry pasta that tastes like more effort than it is.

ingredients.name: parmesan
ingredients.original: 1/2 cup grated parmesan, plus more for serving

steps.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until just tender, about 10 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the garlic just until fragrant and golden at the edges, about 1 minute — do not let it burn.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and simmer for 1 more minute until the sauce turns a soft, rosy color.
Add the drained spaghetti to the sauce along with the parmesan, tossing and adding a splash of the reserved pasta water if it looks dry.
Remove from the heat, fold in the fresh basil, and serve with extra parmesan on top.

title: Baked Salmon with Lemon
summary: Flaky, buttery salmon with bright lemon and barely any cleanup. A weeknight staple that never feels like a compromise.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.original: 1 lemon, half sliced thin and half juiced

steps.step: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with foil for easy cleanup.
Pat the salmon fillets dry and set them skin-side down on the foil, spaced apart.
Stir the melted butter, lemon juice, garlic, and dill together in a small bowl.
Spoon the butter mixture evenly over each fillet, then season with salt and pepper.
Lay the lemon slices over the top of the fillets.
Bake until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and looks opaque in the center, about 12 to 15 minutes depending on thickness.
Let the fillets rest for a couple of minutes before serving so the juices settle.

title: Air Fryer Salmon
summary: Crisp on the outside, tender all the way through, and done before the air fryer even finishes preheating in your head. No oven required.

steps.step: Pat the salmon fillets dry with a paper towel so the seasoning sticks.
Rub both sides of each fillet with olive oil.
Sprinkle the garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper evenly over the fillets.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F for about 3 minutes.
Place the fillets skin-side down in the basket in a single layer, without crowding.
Air fry until the outside is lightly crisp and the center flakes easily with a fork, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Serve hot with the lemon wedges squeezed over the top.

title: Shrimp Scampi
summary: Garlicky white wine sauce clings to every strand of pasta, with plump shrimp tucked in throughout. Restaurant date-night energy, homemade.

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.original: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine until just short of tender, about 1 minute less than the package says. Scoop out a cup of the pasta water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, pat the shrimp dry and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil and half the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until the butter melts.
Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook until pink and just curled, about 1 to 2 minutes per side. Move them to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium, add the garlic and red pepper flakes, and stir until fragrant but not browned, about 30 seconds.
Pour in the white wine and let it bubble for a minute to cook off the sharp smell, scraping up any browned bits from the pan.
Stir in the remaining butter and lemon juice until the sauce looks glossy.
Add the drained linguine and shrimp to the skillet and toss well, splashing in reserved pasta water a little at a time until the sauce coats the noodles.
Scatter the parsley over the top and serve right away, while the sauce is still glossy.

title: Fish Tacos
summary: Crisp-edged fish, cool crunchy slaw, and a tangy sauce folded into warm tortillas. Bright enough for summer, easy enough for any Tuesday.

ingredients.name: white fish fillets
ingredients.original: 1 lb white fish fillets, such as cod or tilapia

steps.step: Toss the cabbage with the mayonnaise and half the lime juice in a bowl, season with salt, and set aside so it softens slightly while you cook the fish.
Pat the fish dry and rub both sides with olive oil, chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the fish until it flakes easily and is golden at the edges, about 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Move the fish to a plate and break it into large flaky chunks with a fork.
Warm the tortillas in the same skillet, about 20 seconds per side, until soft and pliable.
Fill each tortilla with fish and a spoonful of the cabbage slaw.
Top with cilantro and a squeeze of the remaining lime juice before serving.

title: Tuna Pasta Bake
summary: A creamy, cheesy casserole built from pantry staples that somehow tastes like more than the sum of its parts. Comfort food that reheats beautifully.

ingredients.name: pasta
ingredients.original: 12 oz short pasta, such as penne or fusilli

steps.step: Heat the oven to 375°F and bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta until just tender, then drain and set aside.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat, whisk in the flour, and cook for 1 minute until it smells toasty, not raw.
Slowly whisk in the milk, a little at a time, until the mixture is smooth, then simmer, stirring often, until it thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, about 5 minutes.
Stir in half the cheddar cheese until melted, then season with salt and pepper.
Fold the tuna, frozen peas, and cooked pasta into the sauce until everything is coated.
Pour the mixture into a baking dish and scatter the remaining cheddar cheese and the breadcrumbs over the top.
Bake until the top is golden and bubbling around the edges, about 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Fish and Chips
summary: Shatteringly crisp batter over flaky white fish, with thick golden fries alongside. Pub-night favorite, made in your own kitchen.

ingredients.name: russet potatoes
ingredients.original: 4 large russet potatoes, cut into thick fries

ingredients.name: white fish fillets
ingredients.original: 1 1/2 lb white fish fillets, such as cod, cut into wide strips

steps.step: Soak the cut potatoes in a bowl of cold water for at least 15 minutes to rinse away extra starch, then drain and pat completely dry.
Heat the oil in a deep, heavy pot to 325°F using a thermometer to check.
Fry the potatoes in batches until pale and just soft, about 4 minutes, then lift them out onto a paper towel-lined tray. This first fry cooks them through without browning.
Raise the oil temperature to 375°F while you make the batter.
Whisk 1 cup of the flour with the cornstarch, baking powder, and a pinch of salt in a bowl, then whisk in the cold sparkling water until just combined and a little lumpy — do not overmix.
Pat the fish dry, season with salt and pepper, and dust each piece in the remaining flour, shaking off the excess.
Dip each floured fish piece into the batter, letting the excess drip off, and lower it gently into the hot oil.
Fry the fish until deep golden and crisp, about 5 to 6 minutes, turning once, then drain on a fresh paper towel-lined tray.
Fry the potatoes a second time in the same hot oil until deeply golden and crisp, about 3 minutes, then drain and season with salt right away.
Serve the fish and chips hot with malt vinegar on the side.

title: Shrimp Stir-Fry
summary: Snappy shrimp and crisp vegetables tossed in a glossy savory sauce, all in one pan. Faster than delivery and better the next day.

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.original: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps.step: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, and cornstarch together in a small bowl until smooth and set aside.
Heat half the oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat until shimmering.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and curled, about 2 minutes per side, then move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil to the pan along with the broccoli, bell pepper, and carrot, and stir-fry until bright and just tender-crisp, about 4 minutes.
Push the vegetables to the side, add the garlic and ginger to the open space, and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Return the shrimp to the pan, pour in the sauce, and toss everything together until the sauce thickens and coats the pan, about 1 minute.
Serve hot, straight from the pan.

title: Tuna Melt
summary: Toasty bread, melted cheese, and a creamy tuna filling — a diner sandwich you can pull off in one skillet in under fifteen minutes.

steps.step: Stir the tuna, mayonnaise, and celery together in a bowl, then season with salt and pepper.
Lay out the bread slices and spread the tuna mixture evenly over two of them.
Top the tuna with the cheddar cheese, then close each sandwich with the remaining bread.
Butter the outside of each sandwich on both sides.
Cook the sandwiches in a skillet over medium heat until golden and crisp on the first side, about 3 minutes.
Flip carefully and cook the second side until golden and the cheese has melted through, about 3 more minutes.
Slice in half and serve while the cheese is still warm and stretchy.

title: Salmon Rice Bowl
summary: Warm rice, glazed salmon, and crisp vegetables layered into one satisfying bowl. Simple building blocks, dressed up with a sticky sauce.

ingredients.name: salmon fillets
ingredients.original: 2 salmon fillets (about 6 oz each), skin removed

steps.step: Cook the white rice according to the package directions and keep it warm until ready to serve.
Whisk the tamari, honey, rice vinegar, and sesame oil together in a small bowl.
Pat the salmon dry, place it in a skillet over medium-high heat, and cook the first side untouched until golden, about 4 minutes.
Flip the salmon, pour half the sauce over it, and cook until the fish flakes easily and the sauce turns glossy and slightly sticky, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Break the salmon into large chunks right in the pan, tossing gently to coat in the sauce.
Divide the warm white rice between two bowls and top with the salmon, cucumber, and avocado.
Drizzle the remaining sauce over the bowls and finish with a scatter of sesame seeds.

title: New England Clam Chowder
summary: Thick, creamy, and studded with tender potatoes and clams — the coastal classic that turns a pot of pantry basics into pure comfort.

ingredients.name: canned clams
ingredients.original: 3 cans (6.5 oz each) chopped clams, juice reserved

steps.step: Cook the bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crisp, about 5 minutes, then lift it out onto a paper towel, leaving the fat in the pot.
Add the onion and celery to the bacon fat and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and stir constantly for 1 minute to cook off the raw taste.
Slowly pour in the reserved clam juice from the cans along with the bottled clam juice, stirring to smooth out any lumps.
Add the potatoes and bay leaf, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook until the potatoes are just fork-tender, about 12 to 15 minutes.
